title: Accept standalone hosted setup against the deployed build
text: A committed standalone hosted setup candidate and fixture screenshots cover plain titles, retained named invitation failures, settled URL/Subscription rows and one creation indicator with resumability teaching after 45 seconds. Retained CI founding screenshots, production captures tied to the exact served build, refreshed capture dates and a timed real stage founding journey remain separate pending evidence. Existing production captures remain the serving baseline until deployment and acceptance. Hosted setup delivery owns this proof; private captures and repository evidence remain outside the public map.
